problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-4 & 4 & -2 & 8 \\ -6 & 9 & -3 & 7 \\ 4 & 2 & 1 & -8 \\ 5 & 4 & 3 & 3\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & -3 & -5 \\ 2 & 4 & 1 & -4 \\ -1 & 10 & 3 & 15\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $B$ above. By applying three matrix elementary column operations 

- ${C}_{1}:=…$
- ${C}_{2}:={C}_{2}+2{C}_{3}$
- ${C}_{4}:=…$

each of the form ${C}_{i}:={C}_{i}+k{C}_{3},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the missing elementary column operations?

feedback.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}7 & 5 & 6 & -9 \\ 6 & 4 & 2 & -6 \\ -7 & 2 & -3 & 6 \\ 5 & 6 & 1 & 8\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}-11 & -7 & 6 & 9 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 2 & 8 & -3 & -3 \\ 2 & 4 & 1 & 11\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $B$ above. By applying three matrix elementary column operations 

- ${C}_{1}:={C}_{1}-3{C}_{3}$
- ${C}_{2}:=…$
- ${C}_{4}:=…$

each of the form ${C}_{i}:={C}_{i}+k{C}_{3},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the missing elementary column operations?
feedback.worked_solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make entries to the left and to the right of ${a}_{23}=2$ equal to $0.$

To do this, we can apply the following elementary column operations:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}7 & 5 & 6 & -9 \\ 6 & 4 & 2 & -6 \\ -7 & 2 & -3 & 6 \\ 5 & 6 & 1 & 8\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{1}:={C}_{1}-3{C}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-11 & 5 & 6 & -9 \\ 0 & 4 & 2 & -6 \\ 2 & 2 & -3 & 6 \\ 2 & 6 & 1 & 8\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{2}:={C}_{2}-2{C}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-11 & -7 & 6 & -9 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & -6 \\ 2 & 8 & -3 & 6 \\ 2 & 4 & 1 & 8\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{4}:={C}_{4}+3{C}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-11 & -7 & 6 & 9 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 2 & 8 & -3 & -3 \\ 2 & 4 & 1 & 11\end{aligned}] \\  & =B.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the corresponding elementary column operations are

$\,$ ${C}_{2}:={C}_{2}-2{C}_{3}\,$ and $\,{C}_{4}:={C}_{4}+3{C}_{3}.$
